# Crank Labs

> Crank Labs is an AI consulting, full stack consulting and business transformation firm with offices in Dubai (UAE) and Mumbai (India), founded by Varun and Darpan. One team takes a business from diagnosis to running systems: AI strategy and process redesign, custom software development, AI agents, automation, and Visibility, our AI SEO platform (https://crank-visibility.vercel.app/).

## Services
- [AI consulting](https://cranklabs.tech/ai-consulting/): AI consulting is outside help to decide where artificial intelligence will save time or win revenue in a business, and then to make it work. A useful engagement covers an opportunity audit, use-case prioritisation, a data readiness check, the build, rollout with your team and ongoing governance. Crank Labs runs all of these with one team, so the advice is judged by whether a working system goes live and gets used.
- [Business transformation](https://cranklabs.tech/business-transformation/): Business transformation consulting helps a company redesign how its sales, operations and finance actually run, then build and roll out the new way of working. Crank Labs diagnoses where time and money leak, designs the target process, sets a transformation roadmap tied to revenue, cost and time saved, builds the software and automation, and stays with the team through rollout until the change sticks and pays for itself.
- [AI agent development](https://cranklabs.tech/ai-agents/): AI agent development is building software that understands a request, decides what to do and takes action in your systems: replying on WhatsApp, qualifying a lead, booking a slot and updating the CRM. Crank Labs builds WhatsApp, voice, email and internal operations agents with scoped permissions, full logs and human handover, and a focused first agent is typically live in two to four weeks.
- [AI automation](https://cranklabs.tech/ai-automation/): An AI automation agency designs and runs software that does repetitive back-office work end to end: reading invoices, routing approvals, building reports and entering data into Tally, Zoho, a CRM or an ERP. Crank Labs maps the process first, automates the steps that are frequent and rule-based, keeps a person approving anything financial, and typically has a first workflow live in two to four weeks.
- [Custom software development](https://cranklabs.tech/software-development/): Custom software development means building web apps, portals, dashboards and integrations around how your team actually works, instead of bending the team to fit an off-the-shelf product. Crank Labs scopes each build through a consulting-led diagnosis, connects it to tools you already use such as TallyPrime, Zoho, Microsoft 365 or your CRM, and delivers in phases so results show from the first month.
- [Answer engine optimization](https://cranklabs.tech/answer-engine-optimization/): Answer engine optimization (AEO) is the work of making a business easy for AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews to understand, trust and recommend. It covers consistent entity facts, structured data, pages that answer buyer questions directly, credible third-party mentions and access for AI crawlers. Crank Labs does this work and measures it with Visibility, its own AI SEO platform.

Australian clients are served remotely from Dubai and Mumbai, with calls in Australian business hours.

2. Redesign & build: the target process, built on real data (software, integrations, AI agents, automation)
3. Run & scale: measure, tune, train the team, then take on the next function

## Articles
- [AI for Businesses in the UAE: A Practical Adoption Guide](https://cranklabs.tech/blog/ai-adoption-guide-uae-businesses/): AI for businesses in the UAE works best when it is built around how UAE customers actually behave: they message on WhatsApp first, write in Arabic, English and other languages, and expect fast replies at any hour. The practical starting points are an AI agent that answers and books enquiries on WhatsApp and automation of repetitive finance and admin work, designed from day one to respect the UAE Personal Data Protection Law.
- [AI Strategy Roadmap for SMEs: A Practical 90-Day Plan](https://cranklabs.tech/blog/ai-strategy-roadmap-for-smes/): An AI strategy roadmap for an SME is a short, sequenced plan that takes a business from scattered AI ideas to one or two working systems with measured results. A practical version runs about 90 days: two weeks to diagnose, two to score and choose use cases, six to design, build and pilot, and the rest to roll out, train staff, set governance and decide what comes next.
- [Business Transformation Framework: 7 Steps, Owners and Metrics](https://cranklabs.tech/blog/business-transformation-framework/): A business transformation framework is the sequence a company follows to change how it runs and make that change pay. A practical version has seven steps: diagnose where time and money leak, prioritise one function, redesign the process, build the systems on real data, roll out with the front line, measure outcomes against a baseline, then scale to the next function once the first change pays for itself.
- [Digital Transformation vs Business Transformation: Which First?](https://cranklabs.tech/blog/digital-transformation-vs-business-transformation/): Digital transformation changes the tools a business uses: software, data, automation and AI. Business transformation changes how the business runs: its processes, roles, decisions and the way it makes money. Digital work is usually one part of business transformation, not a substitute for it. Buying software without redesigning the work behind it tends to digitise the existing mess, so most mid-sized businesses should fix the process first, then choose technology to run it.
- [How to Choose an AI Consulting Company: A Buyer's Guide](https://cranklabs.tech/blog/how-to-choose-an-ai-consulting-company/): To choose an AI consulting company, judge it on evidence rather than pitch: working systems it has shipped, engineers who build in-house, a clear view of your process before any tool is named, sensible data handling, and support after go-live. Score shortlisted firms on the same criteria, start with one small, measurable project, and make sure the contract gives you ownership of your data, accounts and documentation.
- [What Is AI Consulting? A Plain-English Guide for Business Owners](https://cranklabs.tech/blog/what-is-ai-consulting/): AI consulting is outside expertise that helps a business decide where artificial intelligence will save time or make money, then designs, builds and rolls out the systems that do it. A good AI consultant maps your processes and data, picks a small number of high-value use cases, builds agents or automations around the tools you already use, trains your team and measures the result. The output is working systems, not a slide deck.
- [What Is Full Stack Consulting? Strategy to Execution in One Team](https://cranklabs.tech/blog/what-is-full-stack-consulting/): Full stack consulting is a model where one team takes a business from diagnosis to working results: strategy and process redesign, software development, AI agents and automation, and the rollout with the client's staff. Unlike management consultants, who stop at the plan, or development agencies, who start at the specification, a full stack consulting firm is accountable for whether the change actually works in the business.
- [Why Transformation Projects Fail, and How to Make Change Stick](https://cranklabs.tech/blog/why-business-transformation-projects-fail/): Transformation projects fail for predictable reasons, not bad luck: advice and build split across different firms, a first scope that is too big, no single owner, measuring activity instead of outcomes, ignoring the people who do the work, data that is not ready, and no run phase after go-live. Each has early symptoms you can spot and a practical fix you can apply before the money is spent.
- [AI Agent vs Chatbot: Which One Does Your Business Need?](https://cranklabs.tech/blog/ai-agent-vs-chatbot/): A chatbot replies to messages from a script or knowledge base, and its job ends when the reply is sent. An AI agent understands what the customer wants, decides the next step and takes action inside your systems: booking the appointment, updating the CRM, raising the quote. If you only need questions answered, a chatbot can be enough. If you need work completed after the conversation, you need an AI agent.
- [WhatsApp AI Agent for Clinics in the UAE: A Practical Guide](https://cranklabs.tech/blog/whatsapp-ai-agent-for-clinics-uae/): A WhatsApp AI agent for clinics replies to every patient enquiry within seconds, answers treatment and pricing questions from information the clinic has approved, books the appointment into the clinic calendar and sends confirmations and reminders. Anything clinical, sensitive or complex is handed to staff immediately. In the UAE, where patients usually message before they call, it is the quickest way to stop enquiries going cold after hours.
- [AI Automation Cost in 2026: What Drives the Price and the ROI](https://cranklabs.tech/blog/ai-automation-cost-small-business/): AI automation is usually priced as a one-time build fee plus a monthly fee that covers hosting, AI model usage, messaging fees, monitoring and ongoing improvements. The cost depends on how many systems the automation connects to, how clean your data is, how much volume it handles and how much human review the workflow needs. The right budget comes from ROI: what the hours saved, errors avoided and leads recovered are worth each month.
- [AEO vs SEO: How to Get Recommended by ChatGPT and AI Search](https://cranklabs.tech/blog/aeo-vs-seo-get-recommended-by-chatgpt/): SEO helps your pages rank in search results and earn a click. AEO (answer engine optimisation) helps your business become the answer that ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews give, and the name they recommend. You win at AEO with pages that lead with clear answers, question-style headings, structured data, consistent business facts across the web and independent sources that mention you. Good technical SEO is still the foundation.
- [AI Bookkeeping Automation for Accounting Firms: Tally and Zoho](https://cranklabs.tech/blog/ai-bookkeeping-automation-accounting-firms/): AI bookkeeping automation collects invoices, receipts and bank statements as they arrive, reads the supplier, dates, amounts, tax and line items, proposes the accounting treatment from each client's own posting history, and queues every entry for an accountant to approve before it posts into TallyPrime or Zoho Books. The firm keeps every judgement call. The AI removes the sorting and the typing, so the same team can serve more clients.
- [AI in Manufacturing Quality Control: Paper Sheets to Dashboards](https://cranklabs.tech/blog/ai-in-manufacturing-quality-control/): AI in manufacturing quality control starts with getting inspections off paper. Inspectors capture checks, measurements and photos on a phone or tablet against a checklist built for each unit, management sees every unit's status on a live dashboard and reports are generated automatically. Once that data exists, AI groups recurring defects by stage or supplier, summarises inspector notes, flags units falling behind and drafts customer-ready QC documentation.

## FAQ
### What does an AI consulting firm do?
An AI consulting firm works out where AI will genuinely save time or make money in your business, then helps you get it working. At Crank Labs that means an operations audit, a prioritised list of use cases, and then building and running the agents, automations and software ourselves, with offices in Dubai and Mumbai. You get working systems, not a strategy deck.

### What is full stack consulting?
Full stack consulting means one team covers the whole business change: strategy and process design, the software and integrations, AI agents and automation, and the rollout with your people. You never hand a consultant’s recommendations to a separate development agency and hope they survive the translation.

### What does business transformation involve?
Business transformation is changing how a company operates so it grows without adding the same amount of cost and headcount. In practice we map how work flows today, redesign the slow or manual parts, build the systems that run the new process, and train your team on it. Most engagements start with one function, such as sales follow-up or finance operations, and expand from there.

### How is Crank Labs different from a consulting firm or a dev agency?
Consulting firms advise and leave; development agencies build what they are told. We do both, so the people who diagnose your business are the people who build and run the fix, and we are measured on whether it works in your operations, not on the deck or the code alone.

### What does an AI automation agency actually do?
An AI automation agency designs, builds and runs AI agents and workflows that take repetitive work off your team: answering leads on WhatsApp, booking appointments, reading invoices, updating your CRM and reporting. Crank Labs does this end to end: audit, build, integration and ongoing management.

### What is the difference between an AI agent and a chatbot?
A chatbot answers questions from a script. An AI agent understands intent, makes decisions and takes actions in your systems. It can qualify a lead, check availability, book the slot, send the confirmation and log it in your CRM without a human in the loop.

### How much does it cost to build an AI agent for my business?
It depends on how many systems the agent connects to and how much volume it handles. Most of our clients start with one focused agent on a fixed build fee plus a monthly managed plan. You get an exact quote after the free audit, with no surprises.

### How long does it take to go live?
A focused agent, such as a WhatsApp lead-response agent or an invoice-entry workflow, is typically live in two to four weeks. Larger multi-system builds are delivered in phases so you see results from the first month.

### Which industries do you work with?
Healthcare (hospitals, dental and aesthetic clinics), manufacturing (including fire-fighting vehicle builders), accounting and bookkeeping firms, jewellery and diamond trade, smart-home and electrical contractors, telecom, hospitality and travel. If your team handles enquiries, documents or repeat follow-ups, we can automate it.

### Can the AI work with WhatsApp, Tally, Zoho and our existing CRM?
Yes. We integrate with the WhatsApp Business Platform, Microsoft 365 and Gmail, TallyPrime, Zoho Books, popular CRMs, calendars and custom databases. We build around the tools your team already uses instead of replacing them.

### Is our customer data safe?
Agents run on infrastructure we control or on your own cloud, with access limited to what each workflow needs. For finance and healthcare workflows we keep a human approval step before anything is sent or posted.

### What is AEO and why does my business need it?
Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) is the practice of structuring your website and content so AI assistants like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews quote and recommend you. More buyers now ask an AI before they search. If you are not in the answer, you are not on the shortlist.

### Where are you based?
Crank Labs has offices in Mumbai and Dubai, and was founded by Varun and Darpan. We deliver for clients across the UAE, India, the UK, the US and Australia, remotely with on-site visits where needed.
